definitions.explanation: The quality of being substantial and rewarding to read; depth and substance in written material.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{読|よ}み{応|ごた}え⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This novel is a worthwhile read.

examples.japanese: {読|よ}み{応|ごた}え⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{記事|きじ}→記事：00227_kiji⟧だった。
⟦{内容|ないよう}→内容：01482_naiyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{濃|こ}くて→濃い：02344_koi⟧{読|よ}み{応|ごた}え⟦{十分|じゅうぶん}→十分：01614_juubun⟧だ。
examples.english: The content is rich and very satisfying to read.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧ (to read) + {応|こた}え (response/worth) → worth reading

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {読|よ}み{応|ごた}え⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (is worth reading, is substantial)
- {読|よ}み{応|ごた}え⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧{本|ほん} (a book worth reading)
- {読|よ}み{応|ごた}え⟦{十分|じゅうぶん}→十分：01614_juubun⟧ (fully satisfying read)

RELATED ～{応|ごた}え WORDS:
- ⟦{見応|みごた}え→見応え：07274_migotae⟧ (worth seeing)
- ⟦{聞|き}き{応|ごた}え→聞き応え：07275_kikigotae⟧ (worth listening to)
- ⟦{歯応|はごた}え→歯応え：07272_hagotae⟧ (chewiness; challenge)
- ⟦{手応|てごた}え→手応え：06635_tegotae⟧ (response; feedback)

USAGE:
Implies depth, substance, and satisfaction. Used positively for content that is engaging and rewarding rather than superficial.
